description: .NET version upgrade plan from .NET Framework 4.8 to .NET 10.0

tasks.reason: The user explicitly requested an upgrade to .NET 10 (LTS). The project targets legacy .NET Framework 4.8 with ASP.NET MVC 5 and outdated dependencies (e.g., EF Core 3.1), so moving to .NET 10 provides long-term support, modern APIs and security updates.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade the project from .NET Framework 4.8 to .NET 10.0, including project file modernization, web framework migration, dependency updates, and API compatibility fixes.
